It's late June. The summer schedule has been full — jackpots, weekend runs, hauling. Your horse has been doing the work.

Most performance horses in North Texas are carrying restriction right now and nobody's checked. By the time it shows up in your times or your stop, it's been building for weeks.

Dr. Leo comes to your barn. No trailering a tired or sore horse. No waiting for a clinic date that fits someone else's schedule.

If it's been more than six weeks, it's time.

Book now — shortgochiro.com or call (406) 799-3369.
